R1.title: Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency
R1.claim: Cryptocurrency returns contain time-series momentum and attention-linked predictability.

R2.title: Intraday Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Markets
R2.claim: Momentum and reversal coexist and change with jumps, liquidity and event regimes.

R3.title: Profitability of Technical Trading Rules in Bitcoin
R3.claim: Trading-range breakouts are regime-dependent and require current cost-adjusted validation.

R4.title: Technical Trading and Cryptocurrencies
R4.claim: Technical-rule primitives require broad systematic testing rather than indicator folklore.

R5.title: Volatility-Managed Portfolios
R5.claim: Inverse-variance risk scaling can improve risk-adjusted performance; crypto transfer requires local validation.

R6.title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
R6.claim: Short-horizon price impact is linked to order-flow imbalance normalized by market depth.

R7.title: High-Frequency Jump Analysis of the Bitcoin Market
R7.claim: Aggressive flow and spread widening are associated with Bitcoin jumps and persistence.

R8.title: Bitcoin Volume and Volatility Periodicity
R8.claim: Volume and volatility vary materially by hour and weekday/weekend state.

R9.title: Bitcoin Intraday Price Discovery
R9.claim: London-New York overlap contributes disproportionately to price discovery and liquidity.

R10.title: Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures
R10.claim: Funding is a basis-alignment mechanism and must not be treated as a standalone directional predictor.

R11.title: Perpetual Futures and Basis Risk
R11.claim: Basis dislocations reflect constrained arbitrage and speculative demand; funding and OI require joint state interpretation.

R12.title: Short-Term Reversal, Momentum and Liquidity in Crypto
R12.claim: Liquidity state can reverse whether a return signal should be owned by momentum or mean reversion.

Y1.title: Triple Screen Trading System
Y1.claim: Multi-timeframe responsibility separation is a testable hypothesis, not profitability proof.

Y2.title: Backtesting Techniques
Y2.claim: Delay, friction, parameter-stability and sequence-risk tests are validation hypotheses only.

turtle_trend.mechanism: Keep the Donchian signal and exits frozen; vary only pre-entry risk scaling using lagged realized volatility.

bb_revert.mechanism: Keep Bollinger reclaim geometry frozen; allow it only in the preregistered liquid non-trend state.

anchor_vwap_trend.mechanism: Keep VWAP trend logic frozen; change only deterministic session ownership using completed bars.

vwap_revert.mechanism: Replace persistent eligibility with the first closed-bar excursion-to-reclaim transition; all exits stay frozen.

break_and_continue.mechanism: Keep breakout and continuation definitions frozen; add one entry-time relative-volume confirmation state.

keltner_trend.mechanism: Keep Keltner signal geometry frozen; change only lagged-volatility risk scaling.

squeeze_break.mechanism: Enter only on the first completed-bar compression-to-expansion transition; no indicator stacking.

supertrend_pullback.mechanism: Keep trend owner and risk geometry frozen; enter only at the first completed-bar pullback-completion transition.

trend_ma_macd.mechanism: Replace persistent MA/MACD alignment with its first false-to-true completed-bar transition.

trend_rider.mechanism: Preserve Supertrend, EMA, ATR stop and timeout; change only persistent eligibility to its first false-to-true transition under a new identity.

liquidity_sweep.mechanism: Keep sweep/reclaim geometry frozen; add only depth-normalized order-flow imbalance at entry time.

scalp_snap.mechanism: Replace raw flow magnitude with order-flow imbalance normalized by contemporaneous depth; keep horizon and exits frozen.

vol_spike_fade.mechanism: Keep spike detection frozen; allow fade ownership only in the preregistered liquid reversal state, otherwise no trade.

range_fade.mechanism: Keep range boundaries and exits frozen; change only the entry-time liquidity regime owner.

fvg_revert.mechanism: Keep the gap definition frozen; require a completed-bar reclaim in a liquid reversal state.

pivot_reversal.mechanism: Keep pivot reversal geometry frozen; exclude only the preregistered jump/persistence state.

rsi_swing_fail.mechanism: Keep RSI swing-failure logic frozen; change only entry eligibility during observable jump states.

alpha_combo.mechanism: Remove exactly one preregistered redundant indicator component while leaving all remaining logic and risk frozen.

ema_ribbon_scalp.mechanism: Replace persistent ribbon alignment with its first completed-bar transition; costs and exits remain frozen.

mfi_rsi_div.mechanism: Keep RSI/MFI calculations frozen; enter only on the first jointly confirmed completed-bar divergence transition.

obv_trend.mechanism: Keep trend direction frozen; change only the contemporaneous price-volume confirmation state.

grid_rebalance.mechanism: Keep grid geometry and entry levels frozen; change only the preregistered time-stop to reduce cost and adverse exposure.

rbreaker_like.mechanism: Split the existing breakout and failed-break reversal modes into separately evaluated identities without changing either rule.

session_bias.mechanism: Keep breakout logic frozen; change only deterministic ownership to completed bars in the London-New York overlap.

sr_levels.mechanism: Keep lower-timeframe breakout execution frozen; source support/resistance ownership from the last completed higher-timeframe bar only.
